exposure: third stage placental complications (retained placenta, adherent placenta, placenta accrete, need for manual removal of the placenta, postpartum curettage, revision of the uterine cavity)
outcome: placental insufficiency associated disorders (hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, stillbirth, preterm delivery)
cohort: A population of 263,023 deliveries from women with and without third stage placental complications.
finding: Third stage placental complications were independently associated with placental insufficiency associated disorders, suggesting a common underlying pathological or inadequate placentation process.
